title: AI-assisted weekly capstone StandUp reports
summary: Capstone teams submit weekly StandUp reports about completed work, plans, obstacles, and responses. A Slack bot returns GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 revisions; students choose whether to incorporate them, and instructors retain original, suggested, and final versions.
